# Injury risk

<!-- Generated by scripts/draft-board/injury_risk.py. Do not hand-edit. -->

Research as of 2026-09-03. 200 players — 88 LOW, 66 MED, 46 HIGH, 0 ?.

Tiers are computed, not typed: each player's cited injury history is scored by the rubric in `injury_risk.py` and cut at fixed thresholds (≥5 HIGH, 3–4 MED, ≤2 LOW) on surgery, the same body part recurring across seasons, age and position. `?` means the research found nothing to go on, not that the player is clean.

Never games played, in either direction: two players with the same injury history tier identically no matter how many games either of them played. The board's own GP columns are a separate signal, and neither scales the other (ADR-0017).
